audit.why: Level chart matches the packet and the mirror: Aatrox owns 1-4, Skill at 6, Master Yi at first item and 2+ items. full phases[N].side and content win[N] already agree row for row.
audit.corrected: No chart change. Aatrox 4/10 early, coin-flip at 6, Yi 6/10 and 8/10 once on-hit lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] calls World Ender a "heal-and-revive spike". Riot's current text has no revive — it fears nearby minions and grants AD, increased healing and Move Speed, extended on a takedown.
audit.why: A player who expects a revive mis-times the whole level 6 all-in. The mirror audit already corrected this same stale wording from Aatrox's side.
audit.corrected: World Ender: AD, Move Speed and increased healing, 120/100/80s. Highlander is 85s. Both land at 6, so it is a genuine coin-flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places call his chain-pull "W (Umbral Dash)". Umbral Dash is his E dash; the chain-pull is Infernal Chains (W). Meditate's channel is never flagged as interruptible.
audit.why: Wrong slot name makes the cooldown advice unusable, and Meditate is a channel — any CC, including World Ender's, cancels it outright.
audit.corrected: Infernal Chains (W) 20/18/16/14/12s is the pull and it grounds; Umbral Dash (E) 9/8/7/6/5s is his dash and carries the passive drain. Alpha Strike (20/19.5/19/18.5/18s) goes untargetable through the pull and Q3 knockup. Never open Meditate under his R.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.late never mentions Grievous Wounds even though anti-heal is the deciding purchase.
audit.why: His passive, Umbral Dash passive drain and World Ender's increased healing all stack against extended on-hit DPS.

edits.before: His R (World Ender) heal-and-revive spike and your Highlander go online together, so this is roughly even. Use Q (Alpha Strike) to dodge his recast Q knockups and Meditate to bleed his ult timer, but do not full-commit unless his abilities are on cooldown.
edits.after: His R (World Ender) gives AD, Move Speed and increased healing — no revive — and your Highlander (85s) answers it. Alpha Strike (20s) goes untargetable through his Q3 knockup, but never Meditate while his R is up: its CC breaks the channel outright.

edits.before: Track his Q sweetspot rhythm and especially his W (Umbral Dash chain-pull) — Meditate or Alpha Strike timing should answer the W catch, and his R (World Ender) is the all-in you must respect from 6 until your item lands.
edits.after: His chain-pull is Infernal Chains (W), 20s at rank 1 — Umbral Dash is his E dash. Alpha Strike (20s) answers the W catch, and World Ender (120s at rank 1) is the all-in you must respect from 6 until your item lands.

edits.before: Aatrox's W (Umbral Dash chain-pull) sets up his sweetspot Q knockup combo — the catch that kills you before your item. Dodge the W zone or Alpha Strike out of it, and respect his R all-in.
edits.after: Aatrox's W is Infernal Chains (20s), the chain-pull that sets up his sweetspot Q knockup — the catch that kills you before your item. Alpha Strike out of the W zone, and respect his R all-in.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability is your key tool — time it to phase through his W (Umbral Dash) pull and his Q3 knockup so his whole combo whiffs. Meditate's damage reduction blunts a single sweetspot Q, and Highlander's slow immunity ignores his Q/W slows once you commit. Anti-heal directly counters his passive and R lifesteal.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability (20s) is your key tool — time it to phase through his Infernal Chains (W) pull and his Q3 knockup so his whole combo whiffs. Meditate blunts a sweetspot Q but any CC breaks the channel, so never start it under his R. Highlander's slow immunity ignores his W slow. Anti-heal counters his passive and E drain.

notes: World Ender carries no revive in Riot's current text; other Master Yi pages may still repeat that stale wording. Infernal Chains (W) also grounds, which denies Alpha Strike as an escape while you are inside the zone — Alpha Strike still dodges the pull damage if cast before the drag, but the kit file cannot confirm whether grounding blocks Alpha Strike specifically, so that claim was left off the page.
